item.title: Casper College opens annual SparkTank for area nonprofits
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — Casper College’s annual SparkTank is now open to applications, giving local nonprofit organizations a chance for a share of $40,000. item.title: (PHOTOS) A heart that won’t quit: Ken Woolsey to marry days after open-heart surgery
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — Just last week, doctors opened up local man Ken Woolsey’s chest to perform quadruple bypass surgery on his heart. Tomorrow, Woolsey will follow that same heart down the aisle to marry the love of his life. item.title: Lawmakers advance bills to protect pregnancy centers, extend Medicaid coverage to birthing facilities
item.description: by Katie Klingsporn, WyoFile A legislative panel on Wednesday advanced a bill aimed at protecting pregnancy centers despite concern that the measure is unnecessary and would create special considerations not afforded to comparable facilities. item.title: Chuck Gray urges stronger LLC oversight as Senate advances registered agent reform
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — Citing a surge in fraudulent limited liability company filings and growing national scrutiny of Wyoming’s business laws, a Senate committee on Friday advanced legislation aimed at tightening oversight of registered agents, a move backed by Wyoming Secretary of State Chuck Gray.
